criteria.requirement: Add Arrow.from_excel(serial, *, date_system, tzinfo=UTC) and Arrow.to_excel(*, date_system). Require string date_system 1900 or 1904 explicitly. Accept finite int/float/Decimal serials excluding booleans, preserve microsecond fractions with Decimal half-even rounding, and return Decimal serials. 1900 serial 0=1899-12-31, 59=1900-02-28, 61=1900-03-01; reject the fictitious [60,61) day and rounding into it. 1904 serial 0=1904-01-01. Negative serials map before the chosen epoch. Interpret values as wall-clock dates in the requested zone, preserve real datetime bounds and existing Unix timestamp get behavior; never guess the date system.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
